trade_manifest.interpretation: Historical exploratory associations; repeated shipping exposures and common crisis shocks limit causal interpretation. Official FX may differ from market rates. Pointwise slope intervals are not simultaneous.

frozen_tolerances.catalog_checks: Strict global identity/type/count coverage, including1900and2100boundaries; unique joins; source catalog vs element identity cross-check. All global events retained even if locally invisible.
frozen_tolerances.failure: A discrepancy blocks trusted status and snapshot promotion pending explicit source/version explanation. Do not widen frozen tolerance in response to results.
frozen_tolerances.local_validation_limit: Published NASA solar local table is an independent published implementation cross-check, not independent physics. Lunar published contact tables/maps check phase times and geographic visibility; source display replay only checks wrapper fidelity. State separate coverage/limitations.
frozen_tolerances.selection: Fixed technical cases before computed local outcomes. One published2006Jerusalem solar table was inspected during source discovery; no computed Jerusalem time series examined before freeze.

astronomy_validation.geographic_validation: One independent published Jerusalem solar case; three lunar contact/qualitative-map cases. No independent lunar numeric-altitude validation.
astronomy_validation.interpretation: Published NASA solar local table is an independent published implementation cross-check, not independent physics. Lunar published contact tables/maps check phase times and geographic visibility; source display replay only checks wrapper fidelity. State separate coverage/limitations.
astronomy_validation.solar_global_type_validation: Pinned catalog raw type, normalized type counts and unique greatest-TD identity join only. Solar numeric elements contain no categorical global P/A/T/H field; independent element/global type agreement applies to lunar only.

limitations: Historical exploratory correlations are not causal or prophetic-fulfillment evidence.
Missing baseline wages and unverified IPC geography remain excluded.
Shipping estimates are not grain imports; official FX may differ from retail markets.
Jerusalem point visibility does not establish visibility throughout Israel; modeled UT1 is not exact UTC.
Earlier audit summaries remain dated historical records.
